name: Chamberlain Turner
source:
A talented chamberlain and close aide and friend of the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url]. Born to House Laor, he learnt his trade under the regents of the Stone Throne. When the Stone Throne was abandoned by [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]King Hugh[/url], Turner aided the King's chamberlain, [url=https://vndb.org/c165642]Albert[/url], and then took to aiding the MC.
